response.title: which 2000w portable power station is the best value
response.answer:
For a 2,000W portable power station, I'd prioritize price per watt-hour (Wh), LiFePO4 battery chemistry, and inverter output over brand name alone.

The sweet spot is usually a unit with 2,000–2,400W continuous AC output and approximately 2,000Wh of battery capacity.

One important distinction: 2,000W tells you how much power it can deliver; 2,000Wh tells you how long it can run. A 2,000W station with only 1,000Wh of storage may look like a bargain but deliver roughly half the runtime of a 2,000Wh model.
